days.reason_en: At 15:36 Asia/Shanghai, the complete observed HF board grew from 5 to 20 papers. The unchanged first five reuse their prior reviews; all 15 late members received complete-abstract screening and independent review with exclusion suggestions. EmoReward and SleuthVLM also received targeted method-body review and independent rereading; PyRUA retains a body follow-up.
